name: knowledge-base
description: Search and maintain markdown knowledge bases indexed into Postgres, with MCP tools and authoring skills.

args:
set -euo pipefail
knowledge_base="$PWD"
for candidate in "$PWD" "$PWD/docs" "$PWD/knowledge-base"; do
  if [ -f "$candidate/knowledge-base-schema.json" ]; then
    knowledge_base="$candidate"
    break
  fi
done
exec "${STUDIO_BIN:-studio}" mcp --knowledge-base "$knowledge_base"

interface.shortDescription: Search and maintain your markdown knowledge bases.
interface.longDescription: Indexes markdown into Postgres and provides retrieval, knowledge-base setup, note authoring, and comment-thread workflows.
defaultPrompt: Set up this knowledge base with Studio.
